overrides.COLDWAR_BRA.1.d: Senior officers debate the balance between command authority and civilian expertise.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA.2.d: A constituent settlement must balance social guarantees with executive authority.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA.3.d: A political opening brings pressure to reorganise the party system and widen civilian competition.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA.4.d: Surging world oil prices raise the cost of imported fuel. The cabinet must decide how to protect investment and manage consumption.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA.5.d: The debt and credit crisis puts public investment under pressure. The cabinet must decide how to negotiate with creditors and protect domestic priorities.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA.6.d: Disagreement over human-rights conditions in US security cooperation puts the military relationship under strain. Brasília must decide whether to retain the agreement.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA.7.d: The labourist movement divides over control of the PTB name, prompting Brizola’s supporters to organise the PDT.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA.8.d: Persistent inflation forces a choice between negotiated stabilisation and continued production-led policy.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_congress_arena_desc: Choose ARENA to lead the governing camp into the next national election.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_congress_historic_ptb_d: Choose the restored PTB to lead the labourist camp into the next national election.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_congress_lacerdist_desc: Give the Lacerdist movement a place on the ballot in the next national election.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_congress_mdb_desc: Put the MDB forward as the opposition’s vehicle in the next national election.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_congress_pds_desc: Choose the PDS to lead the governing camp into the next national election.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_congress_pdt_desc: Choose the PDT to carry Brizola’s labourist programme into the next national election.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_congress_pfl_desc: Give the PFL a place in the democratic coalition for the next national election.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_congress_pmdb_desc: Put the PMDB forward as the principal democratic opposition in the next national election.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_congress_prn_desc: Give the PRN a place on the ballot in the next national election.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_congress_psdb_desc: Choose the PSDB to carry its social-democratic programme into the next national election.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_congress_pt_desc: Choose the PT to represent the workers’ movement in the next national election.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_congress_ptb_late_desc: Choose Ivete Vargas’s PTB to represent its labourist programme in the next national election.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_party_1_1_desc:
(National Renewal Alliance)

ARENA is the regime’s civilian governing party under the post-1965 two-party system. Its party organisation remains distinct from the Armed Forces command.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_party_1_2_desc:
(Democratic Social Party)

The PDS succeeds ARENA as the governing camp reorganises after the return to a multiparty system. It remains a civilian party, distinct from the Armed Forces command.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_party_1_3_desc:
(Liberal Front Party)

The PFL forms from PDS dissidents during the transition and joins democratic opponents of military rule in a civilian coalition.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_party_20_1_desc:
(Lacerdist political movement)

Carlos Lacerda remains an opposition politician with a national following. After his death, allies may continue the movement around Sandra Cavalcanti, his close associate from Guanabara.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_party_20_2_desc:
(National Reconstruction Party)

A separate organisation founded in 1989, the PRN became Fernando Collor de Mello’s presidential vehicle. Its formation does not determine the election result.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_party_2_1_desc:
(Brazilian Democratic Movement)

The MDB is the legal opposition under the post-1965 two-party system, operating within institutions constrained by the military regime.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_party_2_2_desc:
(Brazilian Democratic Movement Party)

The PMDB carries the MDB opposition into restored multiparty politics.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_party_2_3_desc:
(Brazilian Social Democracy Party)

The PSDB represents reformist social-democratic currents that split from the PMDB during constitutional politics.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_party_3_1_desc:
(Brazilian Labour Party, restored pre-1965 organisation)

The original PTB was dissolved in 1965. Restoring its organisation is an alternative political outcome, separate from the party later registered under Ivete Vargas.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_party_3_2_desc:
(Brazilian Labour Party, registered successor)

Ivete Vargas’s group secured the PTB name during party reorganisation, separate from Brizola’s supporters.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_party_3_3_desc:
(Democratic Labour Party)

Brizola’s supporters formed the PDT after losing the PTB name to Ivete Vargas’s group during the party reorganisation.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_party_3_4_desc:
(Workers Party)

The PT emerged from the new union movement and social organisations of the late dictatorship.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_party_nominated_effect_: This organisation will represent its political camp in the next national election.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_register_prn_desc: Register the PRN, a separate organisation formed in 1989 around Fernando Collor de Mello.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_1970_register_ptb_late_desc: Register the PTB organisation led by Ivete Vargas after the 1979 party reform.

overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_policy_event_constitution_op: Give social guarantees priority in the constitutional settlement, increasing the cost of public commitments.
Give the executive more room to govern, at the cost of narrower social guarantees and weaker public consent.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_policy_event_debt_crisis_opt: Accept creditor adjustment to ease borrowing costs, while reducing investment.
Protect domestic investment, accepting higher borrowing costs and a larger fiscal cost from inflation.

overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_policy_event_officer_council: Keep operational authority concentrated in the services, limiting civilian influence over defence administration.

overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_policy_event_oil_shock_optio: Maintain industrial investment through the surge in world oil prices, accepting higher inflation-related fiscal costs.
Restrain consumption to limit inflation-related public costs, accepting lower industrial output.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_policy_event_party_reform_op: Allow a wider range of civilian parties to organise, making the political transition more contested.
Limit the transition through agreement with military leaders, preserving more institutional continuity.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_policy_event_party_split_opt: Recognise PTB and PDT as separate organisations after the dispute over the PTB name.
overrides.COLDWAR_BRA_policy_event_us_rights_optio: Preserve military training ties despite disagreement over human-rights conditions in US security cooperation.
